title: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
description: Duas to be said by one who is resident (staying in place) for someone who is travelling

duas.transliteration: Astawdi`ullāha dīnak, wa amānatak, wa khawātīma `amalik.
duas.translation: I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.
duas.arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُ اللَّهَ ديـنَكَ وَأَمانَتَـكَ، وَخَـواتيـمَ عَمَـلِك
duas.source_reference: Ahmad 2/7, At-Tirmidhi 5/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/155.

duas.transliteration: Zawwadaka 'llāhut-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbak, wa yassara laka 'l-khayra ḥaythu mā kunt.
duas.translation: May Allah give you piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
duas.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التقْوى، وَغَفَـرَذَنْـبَكَ، وَيَسَّـرَ لَكَ الخَـيْرَ حَيْـثُما كُنْـت
